system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

attempts.answer:
{
  "assessment": "insufficient_evidence",
  "confidence": 0.88,
  "supporting_observations": [
    {
      "claim": "Nora Blake launched Dropbox from her workstation; the process ran at medium integrity and loaded a DLL signed by Dropbox, Inc. Dropbox is not listed among the organization's approved services.",
      "claim_type": "inferred_claim",
      "record_ids": ["T038-00015", "T038-00016", "T038-00017"]
    },
    {
      "claim": "Nora Blake launched Remote Desktop and connected from WS-NBLAKE-01 to FILE-NWD-01; the file server recorded a successful type 10 logon for her.",
      "claim_type": "observed_fact",
      "record_ids": ["T038-00034", "T038-00037", "T038-00038"]
    },
    {
      "claim": "Nora Blake later launched Remote Desktop to DC-NWD-01 from WS-NBLAKE-01, and the domain controller recorded a successful type 10 logon. This differs from the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-SOKAFOR-01, but the records do not show what she did in the session.",
      "claim_type": "inferred_claim",
      "record_ids": ["T038-00051", "T038-00053", "T038-00054", "T038-00057", "T038-00058"]
    },
    {
      "claim": "A file named KB5034441_update.exe ran from the workstation's Windows Temp directory with the /quiet argument at medium integrity; the available records do not establish its provenance or purpose.",
      "claim_type": "observed_fact",
      "record_ids": ["T038-00061", "T038-00062"]
    }
  ],
  "known_telemetry_limitations": [
    "DC-NWD-01 winsec and sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage, overlapping the alert's reported account-creation time.",
    "The supplied records contain no direct account-creation event for ext.rwong. The outage prevents using the listed DC winsec and sysmon coverage to determine whether such an event occurred during that period.",
    "The records show successful RDP logons but do not capture the actions taken inside Nora Blake's sessions."
  ],
  "claims_not_established": [
    "Whether ext.rwong was created, who created it, or when it was created; the alert reports creation, but the supplied records do not independently document it.",
    "Whether ext.rwong was added only to Freelancers or was granted other group membership or privileges.",
    "Whether Nora Blake's RDP activity was authorized for a particular support task or was related to the reported account.",
    "Whether Dropbox was used to transfer organizational data.",
    "Whether KB5034441_update.exe was a legitimate patch or a malicious or unauthorized executable.",
    "Whether the observed activity was malicious rather than unauthorized or otherwise explainable."
  ],
  "recommended_action": "collect_more",
  "additional_evidence_needed": [
    "Obtain any surviving Active Directory audit records, DC logs, or other audit sources for the reported account creation, including the creator, timestamp, and resulting group memberships and privileges.",
    "Review endpoint or session telemetry for Nora Blake's RDP sessions to FILE-NWD-01 and DC-NWD-01, including commands, process activity, and account-management actions.",
    "Establish the provenance, hash, signature, and download or deployment source of KB5034441_update.exe.",
    "Check endpoint and network records for Dropbox activity and any associated file transfers.",
    "Check for a support ticket, change record, or other authorization explaining Nora Blake's remote access to the servers."
  ]
}

supporting_observations.claim: Nora Blake launched Dropbox from her workstation; the process ran at medium integrity and loaded a DLL signed by Dropbox, Inc. Dropbox is not listed among the organization's approved services.
Nora Blake launched Remote Desktop and connected from WS-NBLAKE-01 to FILE-NWD-01; the file server recorded a successful type 10 logon for her.

Nora Blake later launched Remote Desktop to DC-NWD-01 from WS-NBLAKE-01, and the domain controller recorded a successful type 10 logon. This differs from the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-SOKAFOR-01, but the records do not show what she did in the session.
A file named KB5034441_update.exe ran from the workstation's Windows Temp directory with the /quiet argument at medium integrity; the available records do not establish its provenance or purpose.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-NWD-01 winsec and sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage, overlapping the alert's reported account-creation time.

The supplied records contain no direct account-creation event for ext.rwong. The outage prevents using the listed DC winsec and sysmon coverage to determine whether such an event occurred during that period.
The records show successful RDP logons but do not capture the actions taken inside Nora Blake's sessions.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was created, who created it, or when it was created; the alert reports creation, but the supplied records do not independently document it.
Whether ext.rwong was added only to Freelancers or was granted other group membership or privileges.
Whether Nora Blake's RDP activity was authorized for a particular support task or was related to the reported account.
Whether Dropbox was used to transfer organizational data.
Whether KB5034441_update.exe was a legitimate patch or a malicious or unauthorized executable.
Whether the observed activity was malicious rather than unauthorized or otherwise explainable.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain any surviving Active Directory audit records, DC logs, or other audit sources for the reported account creation, including the creator, timestamp, and resulting group memberships and privileges.
Review endpoint or session telemetry for Nora Blake's RDP sessions to FILE-NWD-01 and DC-NWD-01, including commands, process activity, and account-management actions.
Establish the provenance, hash, signature, and download or deployment source of KB5034441_update.exe.
Check endpoint and network records for Dropbox activity and any associated file transfers.
Check for a support ticket, change record, or other authorization explaining Nora Blake's remote access to the servers.
